snippet.title: Shroom and Gloom | Announcement Trailer | A Moody Roguelike Double-Deckbuilder | Demo Available Now
snippet.description:
Wishlist and download the Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3271280/Shroom_and_Gloom/

Shroom and Gloom is a first-person, roguelike DOUBLE-DECKBUILDER that brings you mobs of monstrous mushrooms and mountains of mega-combos!

Unleash cards to hack, slash, and roast through hand-drawn dungeons of fungal foes! Build devastating decks and grow cards into massive abominations as you fight your way into the heart of The Gloom!

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/w6FnuFcJ83
